svg.title: Same question, two models. The quality bar is set first: the answer must explain how indexes work and name one tradeoff. The question about database indexes goes to gpt-5.6-luna, the cheap tier, which answered correctly with two tradeoffs for $0.000535, and to gpt-5.6-sol, the premium tier at five times the price, which answered correctly with one tradeoff for $0.001775. Premium cost 3.3 times more for no better answer; not the full 5 times, because the cheap model wrote a longer answer.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
